critical_code_review_comments: LocationPickerModal.jsx handleSave: URL validation only checks the `^https?://` prefix — accepts anything after (e.g. 'https://evil.example/'). Fine for now (opens via target=_blank noopener), but consider whitelisting google.com/maps, maps.google.com, maps.app.goo.gl, goo.gl/maps hosts for stricter safety.

ProviderAvailability.jsx uses hard-coded Python weekday convention on the client side to work around a backend mismatch. If backend is ever fixed to accept 0=Sun..6=Sat, both jsToPyWeekday() and pyToJsWeekday() must be removed together — leave a comment near the helpers pointing to backend model so a future dev doesn't remove one and forget the other. Currently the block comment on L10-13 does that well — no action needed, just noted.

ReceptionistDashboard.jsx isAutomobile string check is case-insensitive on 'automobile' only. If backend ever returns 'Auto', 'AUTOMOBILE_SERVICE', or a translated string, branch will silently fall back to non-auto. Keeping the category_id fallback is a solid defensive belt-and-suspenders — good.

Playwright quirk noted: `[data-testid="onboarding-save-btn"]` receives Playwright clicks that DO NOT dispatch the React onClick handler (no network request fired). The same button dispatched correctly when triggered via `el.click()` in evaluate(). Product code is fine — this is a Playwright/animation timing artifact worth flagging for future test scripts (prefer `page.evaluate` for this particular button, or click a specific inner element).
HistoryPage.jsx L261: `disabled={!phone}` correctly guards against clicking names for anonymous walk-ins, but the disabled state uses only CSS classes; consider adding `aria-disabled` for a11y.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — this iteration validated bugfixes for the 5 issues found during mobile-app parity pass. All fixes work as designed. FIX-1 root cause was the JS getDay() (0=Sun) vs Python weekday() (0=Mon) mismatch — bridged in ProviderAvailability.jsx via jsToPyWeekday/pyToJsWeekday helpers, confirmed by direct backend curl showing weekday=0 stored after UI clicked Mon. FIX-3 root cause was checking category_id against a constant that never matched because /queue/today returns provider.category as a STRING — fix uses `(providerInfo?.category || '').toLowerCase() === 'automobile'` with the id fallback preserved. Both mitigations are correct and complete.
